exec: echo canary probe start; seq=%RNDM=0; if [ ! -d kit ]; then tar xzf canary-kit.tgz; fi; export CANARY_PRMON=$PWD/kit/prmon; PYTHONPATH=$PWD/kit python3 -m canary landing --payload-seconds 60 -o landing-report.json; rc=$?; echo CANARY-REPORT-BEGIN; cat landing-report.json; echo CANARY-REPORT-END; exit $rc
